summary: Source tracing found Android FrameCapturer allocated a direct ByteBuffer then called array(), which is unsupported; the native buffer copy is fixed and regression-tested. The signed Android 1.0.15+20 arm64 build successfully delivered a full portrait screen to the macOS 1.0.15+20 Debug viewer. The 2026-10-01 investigation added bounded non-sensitive diagnostics and found the compact Android participant strip did not consume the thumbnail map. After fixing that UI path, Pixel sender diagnostics reported send=published and the muted Pixel participant strip displayed the thumbnail. Remote thumbnail receipt/display remains unverified because the Mac Debug client became stuck at guild initialization before the paired check.

checks.name: Pre-fix Pixel-to-Mac screen-share baseline
checks.observation: With Android 1.0.14+19, the Pixel share was visible on the Mac Flutter viewer from top status bar to bottom navigation with letterboxing and no apparent frame crop. The Mac participant card showed the profile avatar and 'Смотреть экран' control, not a screen thumbnail; the Pixel participant card also retained its avatar. During initial mobile navigation, tapping the voice channel directly entered voice with the microphone active; this was noticed and left immediately. The subsequent screen-share run used the explicit listener-only path, and both clients showed muted microphones throughout that run.

checks.name: Android FrameCapturer direct-buffer regression before fix
checks.observation: The new native test failed to compile before implementation because FrameCapturer.copyBufferBytes(ByteBuffer,int) did not exist. Source inspection confirmed the old path called ByteBuffer.array() on a buffer created with allocateDirect().

checks.name: Android direct-buffer copy regression after fix
checks.observation: Native Flutter WebRTC Android unit tests pass, including the regression that copies bytes from a direct ByteBuffer without array().

checks.observation: All 300 Flutter tests pass and flutter analyze reports no issues.

checks.name: Post-fix Pixel 7 to macOS 1.0.15+20 live screen-share preview
checks.observation: On 2026-09-30, Pixel 7 shared the entire display in SHARE_TEST with its microphone visibly muted. The restarted Mac Debug client joined with its microphone muted and displayed the portrait stream from top status bar through bottom navigation, centered with black side bars and no apparent crop. The Mac showed a 'Смотреть экран' participant-card control, stream statistics, and approximately 5–6 ms voice ping. The stream was stopped, then Mac and Pixel left the voice room. The participant card did not show a captured thumbnail before opening the stream; thumbnail acceptance remains open.

checks.name: Thumbnail visibility before compact-strip UI fix (historical observation)
checks.observation: Before the compact-strip fix, the 2026-10-01 Pixel participant tile showed its avatar despite the local share preview rendering. A later Pixel-only run verified that the compact strip now displays the thumbnail (see the PASS check below). The Mac was not a valid receiver for the later verification because its rebuilt Debug client remained on the guild initialization screen; do not treat the earlier participant-card observation as current remote acceptance.

checks.name: Thumbnail sender pipeline stage regression tests
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub test/screen_thumbnail_pipeline_test.dart test/screen_thumbnail_test.dart
checks.observation: Tests cover capture failure, encoding failure, invalid JPEG rejection, local preview plus publish success, cancellation after sharing stops, and publish failure without hiding the local preview. Tests pass; Android runtime execution is separately recorded in the sender-stage PASS check below.

checks.name: Pixel compact participant-strip thumbnail after UI fix
checks.command: adb install -r desktop/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-arm64-v8a-release.apk; start muted Pixel share; inspect participant strip
checks.observation: The signed Android 1.0.15+20 APK installed over the existing app without clearing data. On a subsequent Pixel-only SHARE_TEST run, the compact participant strip rendered the live screen thumbnail after the sampling interval; microphone remained muted and the share stopped normally.

checks.name: Pixel screen-thumbnail sender runtime stage
checks.observation: Instrumented Pixel logcat reported '[screen-thumbnail] send=published'. The line contains no participant identity, image bytes or raw exception.

checks.name: Full Flutter suite and analyzer after thumbnail strip fix
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub && flutter analyze --no-pub
checks.observation: All 311 Flutter tests pass and flutter analyze reports no issues.

checks.name: macOS receiver-stage live test
checks.observation: The Debug app built and Flutter VM service started, but the window remained on 'Подключаемся к гильдии…'. A separate unauthenticated GET to the public maintenance endpoint returned HTTP 200 in 0.025s; this does not identify why app initialization is waiting. No receiver-stage event could be observed.

latest_update: 2026-10-01: Instrumented Pixel logcat reports send=published. The signed Android 1.0.15+20 APK was rebuilt and installed over the existing app without clearing data; a subsequent muted Pixel-only SHARE_TEST showed the captured screen thumbnail in the compact participant strip after the sampling interval. The Mac Debug build remained at 'Подключаемся к гильдии…'. A process sample and securityd log now confirm it is waiting for Keychain authorization on service .session.v3; details in QA-163. Remote Mac receiver logs and card acceptance remain pending until startup is unblocked.
